title: Selection procedures and protected holdouts
outcome: Evaluate a complete model/prompt selection procedure without using final outcomes to choose the winner.

exercises.title: Two noisy candidates
exercises.task: Enumerate the four two-candidate noise combinations.
exercises.hint: Only the all-negative combination has a negative maximum.
exercises.answer: Three combinations select+0.1 and one selects-0.1, giving(0.3-0.1)/4.

exercises.title: Change only final outcomes
exercises.task: Alter the outer outcomes while retaining development scores.
exercises.expected: The selected candidate IDs do not change.
exercises.hint: Selection must be a function of development information only.
exercises.answer: This invariant distinguishes assessment from a hidden second round of tuning.

exercises.title: Specify a tie rule
exercises.task: Give equal development scores to two candidates.
exercises.expected: The reference chooses the first candidate deterministically.
exercises.hint: NumPy argmax returns the first maximum.
exercises.answer: Tie handling is part of a reproducible procedure; it should not depend on which final outcome is better.

exercises.title: Find the optimistic procedure
exercises.task: Select using the outer table in case B.
exercises.expected: Its same-table average is 0.85, but it is no longer protected assessment.
exercises.hint: Trace which labels selected each candidate.
exercises.answer: The larger score is explained by using outcome information twice, not by evidence that the original procedure improved.

exercises.title: Place preprocessing
exercises.task: Decide where a learned normalization or calibration fit belongs.
exercises.hint: Data-dependent transforms are part of model fitting.
exercises.answer: An outer holdout can leak through a transform even when the final estimator receives only training rows.

exercises.title: Reclassify a reused holdout
exercises.task: Use final-set errors to revise a prompt.
exercises.expected: The set becomes development or regression evidence for that revision.
exercises.hint: A file name does not preserve independence.
exercises.answer: Acquire a new protected assessment for the changed procedure rather than claiming the original untouched-test interpretation.
